South of Denmark

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Not the easiest, but the administration at the host university were good and fast at replying on email.

questions.answer:
Yes, quite easy. I found it through
Uniplaces.com
. A bit expensive.

questions.answer: There are a lot of scams if you find a place through Facebook.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Everything will work out fine. No need to stress. The process is not as rigid as in Copenhagen.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Smaller classes. Exams were different. Mostly hand-written or online.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Behavioural Economics, Public Economics, Advanced Macroeconomics, Computer Programming, Law and Economics of Corporate Governance.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Computer Programming - good introduction to python. Not very elaborate though.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: We noticed how Italians are more extroverted and less passive aggressive - which is both challenging and a good thing.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Find housing early - the housing supply is small
Do not worry about courses etc. It will all work out fine
Drink at least one espresso or cappuccino every day
